question_text: How many confirmed human cases of H5N1 will be reported in the US by February 28, 2025, according to the US dashboard?
resolution_criteria: The number of cases reported by the US dashboard as of February 28, 2025.
comparison_to_outcome: The forecast was accurate, with the vast majority of forecasters correctly anticipating the case range.
takeaways: The majority of group members agreed on the outcome being in the 70 to 100 case range. This was confirmed by the real-world outcome as well.

question_text: How many confirmed human cases of H5N1 will be reported in the US by January 1st, 2026?
resolution_criteria: The number of cases reported by the US dashboard as of January 1st, 2026.
comparison_to_outcome: US H5N1 human cases stayed at 70 (since Apr 2024) with no new cases reported through Dec 2025, placing the Jan 1 2026 count in the 70-100 bucket.
takeaways: Manually resolved 2026-06-21. CDC FluView wks 50-51 (2025) reported no new H5 cases. See bfg-manual-resolutions.md.

question_text: How many US states will have reported human cases of H5N1 by February 28, 2025?
resolution_criteria: The number of individual US states with reported human H5N1 cases as indicated on the official US dashboard as of February 28, 2025.
comparison_to_outcome: The underlying data suggested 15 states had reported cases on February 28th.
takeaways: CAVEAT: buckets overlap at 15 (10-15 vs 15-20). Resolved by the half-open convention (10-14, 15-19, ...), placing 15 in the 15-20 option. See bfg-manual-resolutions.md.

question_text: What is the likelihood that H5N1 will cause 5 or more human deaths in the US by May 1st, 2025?

comparison_to_outcome: Only one US H5N1 human death occurred (Louisiana, Jan 2025), fewer than 5 by May 1 2025.
takeaways: Manually resolved 2026-06-21. CDC/LDH confirmed a single death. See bfg-manual-resolutions.md.

question_text: What is the probability of a new virus outbreak before May 1st, 2025?
resolution_criteria: A new Marburg virus outbreak is confirmed if >=5 human cases are reported before May 1st, 2025.
comparison_to_outcome: Tanzania declared a Marburg outbreak (Kagera) in Jan 2025 with 10 cases/10 deaths (Jan-Mar 2025), exceeding the >=5 threshold before May 1.
takeaways: CAVEAT: 2 confirmed + 8 probable (10 total) - >=5 holds only if probable cases count. Forecast revisions suggest forecasters took seasonality into account. See bfg-manual-resolutions.md.
